name: Ramapo Country Day Camp
description_short: Family owned day camp on 35 acres in Airmont for campers entering Nursery to 8th grade, with four heated pools and Red Cross swim, specialist run sports, arts, science and robotics, an adventure course with zip lines and go carts, and riding lessons from 2nd grade. Busing and a hot lunch cooked on site are included.

sessions.name: Full summer (8 weeks, no camp July 5)

notes: Full day 9 to 4; a Mini Day 9 to 2 is offered for Nursery and Pre-K. Flex 7 and Flex 6 options let families pick any 7 or 6 weeks. All sessions include transportation and lunch. Busing serves most of Manhattan and Bergen County and parts of Brooklyn. Rates are not posted; the camp asks families to request them. Dates may change with school closing dates.
